projects.name: Corporate Actions Processing Platform (GCAPP)
details: • Led end-to-end business analysis for the Portfolio Service System (PSS), supporting global corporate actions processing across
multiple markets and asset classes
• Collaborate with operations, product owners, and technology teams to gather, analyze, and document business requirements
(BRD, FRD, user stories)
• Conduct AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities
• Facilitate stakeholder workshops to define requirements for mandatory and voluntary corporate actions, including client election
workflows Contributed to defining the Target Operating Model (TOM) by documenting future-state operating processes,
governance controls, business rules, and stakeholder responsibilities for global corporate actions processing.
• Facilitated business workshops to validate future-state operating models, ensuring alignment between Operations, Product
Owners, Technology, and Business stakeholders.
• Performed Business Capability Assessment to identify process gaps, capability improvements, and automation opportunities
across the corporate actions lifecycle.
• Developed Process Architecture documentation, including end-to-end process flows, business workflows, and operational control
models to support enterprise transformation initiatives.
• Translate complex business needs into functional specifications aligned with mainframe system capabilities
• Perform data mapping and reconciliation analysis for entitlements, payments, and exception handling
• Define test strategies, test cases, and UAT scenarios in collaboration with QA teams
• Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including defect triage, tracking, and business sign-off
• Act as a liaison between business and technology teams to ensure timely and accurate solution delivery
• Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for production issues and recommended system/process improvements
• Support change management, impact analysis, and release coordination activities

projects.name: Reconciliation & Transaction Lifecycle Platform (ERTLP)
details: • Lead end-to-end business analysis for the TLM platform, supporting reconciliation of cash and securities across internal systems
and external counterparties. Collaborate with operations, custody, and technology stakeholders to gather, analyze, and
document business requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories)
• Conducted Business Capability Mapping to identify functional ownership, upstream/downstream process dependencies, and
opportunities for standardization across reconciliation platforms.
• Supported Operating Model Transformation initiatives by redesigning reconciliation workflows, improving governance, and
enhancing operational controls across trade, cash, and securities reconciliation.
• Developed end-to-end Process Architecture and workflow models using BPMN/UML to support reconciliation modernization and
strategic transformation initiatives.
• Collaborated with Product, Operations, Technology, and Business stakeholders to define future-state reconciliation capabilities
and business operating procedures.
• Performed Impact Assessments and transformation planning for new reconciliation capabilities, ensuring alignment with business
objectives and technology roadmaps.
• Conduct AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis to identify inefficiencies and define optimized reconciliation workflows
• Define and document matching rules, break categories, and exception handling workflows for reconciliation processes
• Facilitate stakeholder workshops to align on requirements for internal and external reconciliation, including custodians and
brokers
• Perform data mapping and data normalization analysis across trade, cash, and position data from multiple source systems
• Work closely with development teams to define API specifications for data ingestion, matching engine execution, and reporting
services
• Support design and implementation of real-time and batch reconciliation processes & Develop functional specifications, data
dictionaries, and process flow diagrams (UML, workflow diagrams)
• Partner with QA teams to define test strategies, test cases, and reconciliation validation scenarios
• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including defect management, resolution tracking, and business sign-off
• Monitor reconciliation breaks, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and recommend rule tuning and process improvements
• Support dashboard and reporting requirements, including KPIs, ageing analysis, match rate, and exception summaries
• Ensure adherence to risk and control frameworks, including audit trails, maker-checker controls, and SLA tracking
• Act as a liaison between business and technology teams to ensure timely delivery and alignment with business objectives

projects.name: Enterprise Client Service & Case Management Platform (ECSMP)
details: • Lead business analysis to transform email-based client servicing into a centralized, SLA-driven case management system.
• Gather and document requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) and define end-to-end case lifecycle workflows including intake,
assignment, escalation, and closure
• Collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to design APIs, data models, dashboards, and reporting for real-time
tracking and performance monitoring
• Drive UAT, ensure audit compliance, and deliver process improvements to enhance SLA adherence, transparency, and operational
efficiency
• Designed end-to-end Client Journey Maps covering case intake, assignment, escalation, resolution, and closure to improve
customer experience and operational efficiency.
• Supported the definition of the Target Operating Model (TOM) for centralized case management by standardizing workflows,
governance, SLA management, and ownership across business functions.
• Conducted Customer Journey Mapping workshops with business stakeholders to identify pain points, optimize service delivery,
and improve operational transparency.
• Defined future-state business processes and operating procedures supporting enterprise-wide client servicing transformation.

projects.name: Operational Automation & Controls Platform (Baseline)
details: • Lead business analysis to identify and automate high-risk operational processes, including corporate action payments on loaned
securities at BNY Mellon
• Gather and document requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories) and define workflows for tax withholding, Section 302 processing,
and automation use cases
• Collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to implement automation solutions, reducing manual effort, improving
processing efficiency, and strengthening operational controls
• Supported Business Process Transformation initiatives by identifying automation opportunities, improving operational controls,
and strengthening governance frameworks.
• Performed Business Capability Assessment and Gap Analysis to prioritize automation initiatives and enhance operational
resilience.
• Collaborated with business and technology teams to translate strategic business objectives into scalable functional solutions
supporting future-state operating models.

projects.name: Documentation & Reconciliation Optimization
details: • Performed detailed validation and reconciliation of derivative documentation by verifying economic parameters and matching
system data, ensuring accuracy and timely discrepancy resolution.
• Generated and analyzed monthly business reports on valuation statements and query trends, enabling improved tracking,
transparency, and decision-making.
• Managed high-volume operations with strong SLA adherence, minimizing errors and enhancing overall process efficiency and
data quality.
